claims.source_quote_ar: (لَا يَمَسُّهُ) : هُوَ نَفْيٌ. وَقِيلَ: هُوَ نَهْيٌ حُرِّكَ بِالضَّمِّ.
claims.claim_ar: حرف «لَا» للنفي، وقِيلَ إنه نَهْي (أَيْ لَا النَهْيِ) ويُذكر أنه يُحَرَّك بالضَّمّ.
claims.claim_en: The particle 'lâ' functions as a negation; it is also said to be a prohibition (nahi), and is reported to be pronounced/treated with a dhamma.

warnings: The cited passage in al-Tibyan discusses the particle «لَا» with the example «لَا يَمَسُّهُ». It is a general treatment of the particle rather than a commentary specifically on S20:A68; the application to this ayah is extrapolated.
